_doc: Registry of terrain shader presets. Each preset names a .gdshader file plus default uniform values that complete the look. The stager reads this to pick a shader by --shader-preset NAME (or use the default 'topdown'). User-supplied --triplanar overrides the preset default.

topdown.description: Pure top-down UV. Recommended for ARPG iso/topdown character cam. Cleanest tessellation; texture stretches on near-vertical cliff faces. Default.

triplanar.description: Slope-aware top-down + cliff blend. Removes cliff stretch but introduces visible artifacts on peaky terrain (e.g. mana_crystal cliffs). Use for first-person scenes.

hextile.description: RESERVED — Mikkelsen 2022 hex-tiling. Stochastic per-hex-cell UV offset+rotation breaks visible repeats AND eliminates cliff stretch. Implementation pending; falls back to topdown if shader file missing.

heightblend.description: RESERVED — height-based splat blending instead of weighted average. Sharp pebble-into-sand transitions at biome boundaries; drops the gaussian splat blur dependency. Implementation pending; falls back to topdown.
